evidence.original_label: 分产品 半导体自动化测试系统 营业收入

notes: Tool-resolved product-line revenue for the issuer's ATE mainframes. 测试系统 (ATE mainframes) only, not handlers or probers. The filing scopes these to power semiconductors (diode/MOSFET/IGBT/SiC/GaN and power modules), small-signal discretes, analog and mixed-signal ICs and, newly, the QT-9800 SoC tester. Memory test is described at p17 as a segment where Advantest/Teradyne/COHU hold a dominant position and where domestic firms are still 'breaking through'; the issuer claims no memory-test product, shipment or qualification. The KGD wording in this filing (p10 车规类碳化硅 KGD 测试; p25 晶圆级 KGD 测试系统研发项目, 验证阶段) is SiC/power-device known-good-die testing, not memory or HBM known-good-die testing.
